dct_description_sm: In this study, we aim to develop a practical procedure and method to address sample integrity from field sampling and sample processing to instrumental analysis for total mercury (THg) studies in snow and ice. This includes field blanks, reproducibility, container type, accuracy and facility backgrounds as well as cross check of data quality using two different mercury analyzers. It also aims to carry out THg archive reconstruction from two sites of glaciers in the High Arctic region after successful development of the snow and ice sampling procedure and method.
dct_title_s: Total mercury in snow and ice samples from Canadian High Arctic ice caps and glaciers: A practical procedure and method for total Hg quantification at low pg g-1 level
